items.problem: Expected "I'm an undergraduate at Johns Hopkins studying Applied Mathematics & Statistics and Economics, class of 2029, and most of my work sits between software engineering, machine learning, and product. Right now I build the machine-learning core of an anomaly-detection and alert-prioritization system at Summer Atlantic Capital / SAC Nexus, where I own the event-ingestion pipeline, a versioned FastAPI detection service, temporal sequence models over event streams, a learning-to-rank layer for alerts, and a retrieval-augmented explanation layer so analysts can act on the output. Before that I worked with Intelehealth on AI and data systems for rural telemedicine, including a resource-availability scoring pipeline across 32 villages and an evaluation framework comparing LLM-generated clinical outputs against a 4,169-case standard.
